speaker: Unknown
en: Hi, everybody.
zh: 大家好。

speaker: Unknown
en: Can you hear me?
zh: 能听到我说话吗?

speaker: Unknown
en: So my name is M Shreve, and I work at Automatic.
zh: 我叫 M Shreve,我在 Automatic 工作。

speaker: Unknown
en: And if you're not aware of what Automatic is, we are the company behind WordPress.com and Tumblr and a number of other properties.
zh: 如果你不太了解 Automatic 是什么，我们是 WordPress.com 和 Tumblr 以及其他一系列产品的背后的公司。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we're a fully distributed company with over 1,400 people in 82 countries.
zh: 我们是一家完全分布式的公司，在 82 个国家拥有超过 1400 名员工。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I'm here today to talk about our approach to AI enablement and upskilling our organization to use all of these new tools and ways of working.
zh: 我今天在这里是想谈谈我们在 AI 赋能方面的方法，以及如何提升我们组织使用所有这些新工具和新工作方式的能力。

speaker: Unknown
en: So our but is that you don't just get
zh: 所以我们的「但是」是，你不能仅仅通过把工具交到人们手里就得到

speaker: Unknown
en: Good quality learning or work out of just handing people the tools.
zh: 高质量的学习或工作成果。

speaker: Unknown
en: You need to give them real time to learn and experiment.
zh: 你需要给他们真正的学习和实验时间。

speaker: Unknown
en: So what we've been doing is running these two-week enablement programs where we bring people in in person for a two-week immersive experience.
zh: 所以我们一直在做的是运行这些为期两周的赋能项目，我们把人们聚集到现场，进行为期两周的沉浸式体验。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the way that we do that is through 50% facilitated learning.
zh: 我们的做法是 50% 的引导式学习。

speaker: Unknown
en: Through our learning and development team and our AI enablement team, we pull together workshop hosts from within the company to run workshops and hands-on activities.
zh: 通过我们的学习与发展团队和我们的 AI 赋能团队，我们从公司内部召集工作坊主持人来运行工作坊和动手活动。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we'll look a bit at what that curriculum looks like shortly.
zh: 我们稍后会看一下这个课程体系是什么样子的。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then 50% real project work.
zh: 然后是 50% 的真实项目工作。

speaker: Unknown
en: So we have folks bring in real work that they want to get done or a tool or dashboard that would help them in their day-to-day work.
zh: 所以我们让大家带来他们想要完成的真实工作，或者能帮助他们日常工作中的工具或仪表板。

speaker: Unknown
en: Or these can also be creating new skills or MCPs to enable them to work faster outside of the program.
zh: 或者这些也可以是创建新的技能或 MCP,让他们在项目之外能更快地工作。

speaker: Unknown
en: And another large part of this is encouraging peer sharing.
zh: 另一个很重要的部分是鼓励同伴分享。

speaker: Unknown
en: So sharing their own workflows to show kind of the art of what's possible.
zh: 分享他们自己的工作流程，以展示可能的边界是什么样的。

speaker: Unknown
en: And as they work throughout the two weeks, we also do a number of project demos at the end of each day.
zh: 在这两周的工作过程中，我们每天结束时还会进行多次项目演示。

speaker: Unknown
en: So we've ran three flavors of this, our main set being for engineers, where we go a lot more in-depth, getting into applied AI.
zh: 我们已经运行了三种形式的这种项目，主要的一套面向工程师，我们会更深入，深入到应用型 AI。

speaker: Unknown
en: We've also experimented with cross-functional programs, with product engineering and design getting together in a room, and discussing kind of the future of how we all work together with these new tools.
zh: 我们也尝试过跨职能项目，让产品、工程和设计聚在一个房间里，讨论我们所有人如何用这些新工具协作的未来。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then we've also extended into non-technical teams and run workshops with our finance group, our executive leadership team, and other functions as well.
zh: 然后我们也扩展到了非技术团队，与我们的财务团队、高管领导团队以及其他职能部门一起运行工作坊。

speaker: Unknown
en: So our engineering curriculum starts the first few days, covering the basics, skills, and how to create them, learning how to use MCPs and spectrum and development, as well as kind of the foundations of how to use AI responsibly and how to apply it in a way that's mindful.
zh: 我们的工程课程在最初几天从基础开始，涵盖技能以及如何创建技能，学习如何使用 MCP 和 spectrum 以及开发，以及如何负责任地使用 AI 以及如何以留心的方式应用它的基础。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then we start getting into deeper topics, creating MCPs for new functionality, getting into the hook system of Codex and Claude, and being able to extend the harness that way.
zh: 然后我们开始进入更深入的主题，为新的功能创建 MCP,深入到 Codex 和 Claude 的 hook 系统，并能够以这种方式扩展 harness。

speaker: Unknown
en: up to autonomous agents and running routines and such in the background.
zh: 直到自主智能体，以及在后台运行例程之类的东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then we end on some different applied topics.
zh: 然后我们以一些不同的应用主题结束。

speaker: Unknown
en: So again, Automatic is behind WordPress.com.
zh: 再说一次，Automatic 是 WordPress.com 背后的公司。

speaker: Unknown
en: So we normally run a workshop on applied WordPress AI and some of the cool features that are in WordPress core around AI.
zh: 所以我们通常会运行一个应用型 WordPress AI 的工作坊，介绍 WordPress 核心中围绕 AI 的一些很酷的功能。

speaker: Unknown
en: As well as being able to create your own personal assistant.
zh: 以及能够创建你自己的个人助手。

speaker: Unknown
en: So we really try to walk people from the foundations up into the ability to start creating these new things for themselves.
zh: 所以我们真的试图带领人们从基础一路走到能够开始为自己创造这些新东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: And one thing that we found out is you cannot just write this curriculum once.
zh: 而我们发现的一件事是，你不能只写一次这套课程。

speaker: Unknown
en: As we're all aware, AI is constantly changing from day to day, week to week.
zh: 正如我们都意识到的，AI 每天每周都在不断变化。

speaker: Unknown
en: The top model might be different depending on the latest release.
zh: 顶级模型可能会根据最新的发布而不同。

speaker: Unknown
en: So we're constantly needing to update the curriculum and stay current to make sure when we are running these programs, we're teaching the right thing and we're not teaching six months out of date.
zh: 所以我们不断需要更新课程并保持最新，以确保当我们运行这些项目时，我们教的是正确的东西，而不是教六个月前过时的内容。

speaker: Unknown
en: Another interesting part I wanted to highlight here is we have our own internal MCP server called Context Automatic, and this allows us to rapidly add new tooling sets for MCPs that might not exist or that we want to build our own governance and observability layers on.
zh: 另一个我想在这里强调的有趣部分是，我们有自己内部的 MCP 服务器，叫做 Context Automatic,这让我们能够快速添加新的工具集供 MCP 使用——这些工具可能不存在，或者我们想在上面构建自己的治理层和可观测性层。

speaker: Unknown
en: And one of the cool things that I'll highlight shortly is some of the projects coming out of these cohorts is extending these abilities.
zh: 我稍后会重点介绍的一件很酷的事情是，来自这些批次的学员的一些项目正在扩展这些能力。

speaker: Unknown
en: So as people go through, the capabilities compound and we're able to do more as a company because of that.
zh: 所以随着人们的参与，这些能力会复合增长，我们作为一家公司也因此能够做更多的事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: Another main focus of our program is that these aren't just a number of people that we're sending through.
zh: 我们项目的另一个主要关注点是，这些不仅仅是我们要送过去的一群人。

speaker: Unknown
en: We're also wanting each person we send through to be a multiplier within the company and extend our reach to the folks that we can't get to yet.
zh: 我们还希望我们送过去的每个人都能成为公司内部的倍增器，把我们的影响力扩展到那些我们还无法触及的人。

speaker: Unknown
en: So, so far this year, we've ran seven of these cohorts of groups of about 45 people.
zh: 到目前为止，今年我们已经运行了七个这样的批次，每批大约 45 人。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we're aiming to get around 600 people through these programs by the end of the year, which is about two-thirds of our engineers, as well as some of those other focus areas that I highlighted at the beginning.
zh: 我们的目标是在年底前让大约 600 人通过这些项目，这大约是我们三分之二的工程师，以及我在开头提到的一些其他重点领域的人员。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we would like to equip all these people with ways of sharing their knowledge out and, again, extending our reach.
zh: 我们希望让所有这些人具备分享他们知识的方式，再次扩展我们的影响力。

speaker: Unknown
en: So we've tackled this in a few different ways.
zh: 所以我们通过几种不同的方式来解决这个问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: We are beginning a guides program, or I think other companies call this their champions program.
zh: 我们正在启动一个 guides(向导)项目，我想其他公司把这叫做他们的 champions(冠军)项目。

speaker: Unknown
en: And what we want to do is extend our team's reach into other areas and have these
zh: 我们想做的是把我们团队的影响力扩展到其他领域，让这些

speaker: Unknown
en: like top practitioners that we've identified within the company be able to help us out and continue spreading the knowledge.
zh: 我们在公司内部识别出的顶尖实践者能够帮助我们，继续传播知识。

speaker: Unknown
en: Because we're distributed, we also have began these local AI get-togethers
zh: 因为我们是分布式的，我们也开始举办这些本地 AI 聚会

speaker: Unknown
en: So people that have gone through the program are able to then run these little events within their regions and run workshops and will help support that as well.
zh: 这样，已经完成项目的人就能够在他们的地区运行这些小型活动，运行工作坊，我们也会帮助支持这些活动。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we've done about 10 of those so far in various different areas of the world.
zh: 到目前为止，我们已经在世界各地不同的地区举办了大约 10 场这样的活动。

speaker: Unknown
en: And it's been exciting to see what some of these people that have gone through the program have gone on to do and teach.
zh: 看到一些完成项目的人后来去做的事情和教授的内容，真是令人兴奋。

speaker: Unknown
en: We also organize these things called AI ride-alongs, and these are little workshops that we run
zh: 我们还组织这些被称为 AI ride-along 的活动，这些是我们运行的小型工作坊，

speaker: Unknown
en: Basically showing how you work, how you use a different tool.
zh: 基本上是展示你如何工作、如何使用某个不同的工具。

speaker: Unknown
en: Because what we found is seeing someone in your similar role or in a similar job to you, being able to see how they use it is a lot more easy to grasp than just talking about the concepts.
zh: 因为我们发现，看到一个和你角色相似或工作相似的人，能够看到他们如何使用它，比单纯谈论概念要容易理解得多。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then we're also attempting to build a shared skill and MCP infrastructure.
zh: 然后我们也在尝试构建共享的技能和 MCP 基础设施。

speaker: Unknown
en: So again, that context aid C system that I mentioned, but also encouraging people to create and share skills and build on top of each other's work so that we're all kind of building towards the same kind of platform.
zh: 所以，再次说，就是我提到的那个 context aid C 系统，同时也鼓励人们去创建和分享技能，并在彼此的工作之上进行构建，这样我们所有人都在朝着同一种平台方向构建。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then we have an always on help Slack channel where we also ask people that have gone through this program to help out and just kind of be available for anyone newer to working this way to have a place to come and ask questions at any point of the day.
zh: 然后我们有一个常设的求助 Slack 频道，我们也请那些完成过这个项目的人来帮忙，为那些对这种工作方式还比较陌生的人提供一个随时可以来提问的地方。

speaker: Unknown
en: So I'm going to share a few of the metrics that we've been tracking and improvement we've seen throughout the program.
zh: 所以我要分享一些我们一直在跟踪的指标，以及我们在整个项目中看到的进步。

speaker: Unknown
en: One of these is intentionality and just applying AI to your work in a more thoughtful way.
zh: 其中之一是有意识性，也就是以更有思考性的方式把 AI 应用到你的工作中。

speaker: Unknown
en: Maybe these people came in at the beginning just using it as a chat bot or, you know,
zh: 也许这些人在开始时只是把它当作一个聊天机器人来用，或者你知道的，

speaker: Unknown
en: Not fully using an agentic workflow.
zh: 没有完全使用智能体工作流。

speaker: Unknown
en: So having people be a bit more intentional about how and when they apply AI.
zh: 所以要让人们对如何以及何时应用 AI 更有意识一些。

speaker: Unknown
en: Flow, which is like how well they're able to integrate AI into their workflows.
zh: 心流，也就是他们能够把 AI 整合进自己工作流的顺畅程度。

speaker: Unknown
en: If people feel as if they're able to use it in a way that makes sense for them and not just using it for AI's sake.
zh: 就是人们是否觉得他们能够以对自己有意义的方式使用它，而不是为了用 AI 而用 AI。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then the sharing part, again, is very important to us so that we can continue reaching other people in the company and kind of making everyone a teacher and an expert on these topics.
zh: 然后分享这部分，再次说，对我们来说非常重要，这样我们可以继续触达公司里的其他人，让每个人成为这些话题的老师、成为这些话题的专家。

speaker: Unknown
en: We also track individual lift on various metrics such as skills and custom commands, how comfortable they feel using and applying MCPs, and other topics like context management,
zh: 我们还跟踪各种指标上的个人提升，比如技能和自定义命令、他们使用和应用 MCP 的熟练程度，以及其他像上下文管理这样的话题，

speaker: Unknown
en: And what we've seen from doing various surveys after the program, so we'll do one 72 hours after, 30 days after, and 90 days after, people will continue growing within those 90 days.
zh: 而我们从项目结束后做的各种调查中所看到的——我们会在 72 小时后、30 天后和 90 天后各做一次调查——人们会在这 90 天里持续成长。

speaker: Unknown
en: Being able to apply things more and like they've had more time to experiment and try things.
zh: 能够更多地应用所学的东西，因为他们有了更多时间去实验和尝试。

speaker: Unknown
en: So we're still seeing people like gain confidence and experience even once they've gone through the program.
zh: 所以我们仍然看到人们即使在完成项目之后也在获得信心和经验。

speaker: Unknown
en: So I wanted to highlight just a few of the things that folks have built just within the two weeks of the program.
zh: 所以我想重点介绍几个大家仅在项目的两周内就构建出来的东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: One of these is an agentic analytic system.
zh: 其中之一是一个智能体分析系统。

speaker: Unknown
en: So WordPress has a e-commerce platform plugin called WooCommerce.
zh: WordPress 有一个叫 WooCommerce 的电商平台插件。

speaker: Unknown
en: And some of the people that went through our program
zh: 而一些经历过我们项目的人

speaker: Unknown
en: Created an agentic system for asking questions about your store and getting back answers.
zh: 创建了一个智能体系统，用于就你的店铺提问并得到答案。

speaker: Unknown
en: A number of folks that go through build on top of context AAC.
zh: 有不少经历项目的人在 context AAC 的基础上进行构建。

speaker: Unknown
en: So one of our earlier cohorts, they wanted to be able to use some of these tools for support and build a Zendesk connector, which now we've had adopted through various teams throughout the company.
zh: 所以我们较早的一期学员，他们想能够把其中一些工具用于支持工作，构建了一个 Zendesk 连接器，现在它已被公司里的各个团队采用。

speaker: Unknown
en: We built other providers in there that might not have a native MCP or, again, because we wanted to add additional observability there.
zh: 我们在其中构建了其他可能没有原生 MCP 的提供方，或者，再说一次，因为我们想在那里增加额外的可观测性。

speaker: Unknown
en: We've been building out our own agent skills directory.
zh: 我们一直在构建我们自己的智能体技能目录。

speaker: Unknown
en: We don't prescribe a single tool, so folks are able to use Codex or Claude or any other number of tools, OpenCode, et cetera.
zh: 我们不规定使用单一工具，所以大家可以使用 Codex 或 Claude 或其他任何数量的工具，OpenCode 等等。

speaker: Unknown
en: So we wanted to build our skills directory in a way that can be used across all of those.
zh: 所以我们希望以能够跨所有这些工具使用的方式来构建我们的技能目录。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the whole skills directory actually came out as a project from one of these cohorts as well.
zh: 而整个技能目录实际上也是从其中一期学员的一个项目中诞生的。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then finally, another one I wanted to highlight here is guided admin support.
zh: 最后，我还想在这里重点介绍的另一个是引导式管理支持。

speaker: Unknown
en: So during a help session, say you want to show someone exactly where something is within the dashboard, they built a tool using
zh: 所以在一次帮助会话中，比如说你想向某人准确展示某个东西在仪表盘里的位置，他们构建了一个工具，

speaker: Unknown
en: Claude Code that allowed them to be able to guide and lead a session, highlight different parts of the screen.
zh: 用 Claude Code 构建的，让他们能够引导和主持一次会话，高亮屏幕的不同部分。

speaker: Unknown
en: And this actually came not from an engineer, but one of our support folks that felt a bit more comfortable after going through one of our programs.
zh: 而这个实际上不是来自一名工程师，而是来自我们的一个支持人员，他在经历了我们的一个项目之后感觉更有底气了。

speaker: Unknown
en: That is the end of my presentation, but the one takeaway that I wanted people to take from this is give people real time to actually experiment and learn.
zh: 我的演讲到此结束，但我希望人们从中带走的一个要点是：给人们真正的时间去实际实验和学习。

speaker: Unknown
en: You can't just throw a bunch of tools at them and expect their way of working to change.
zh: 你不能只是朝他们扔一堆工具，然后指望他们的工作方式发生改变。

speaker: Unknown
en: You need to make space and give an environment for learning and make that like the star of whatever your education program is.
zh: 你需要腾出空间，提供一个学习的环境，并让它成为你的教育项目中最重要的主角。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I will be available for questions at our booth, which is the automatic booth right over on the other side near that stage and the swag pickup.
zh: 我会在我们的展位上回答问题，就是另一边靠近那个舞台和周边领取处的 automatic 展位。

speaker: Unknown
en: So I'll be there for a little bit after this talk if you want to talk about anything I talked about here or you'd like to hear more about how we're
zh: 所以我会在这场演讲结束后在那里待一会儿，如果你想聊聊我在这里谈到的任何内容，或者想了解更多关于我们如何

speaker: Unknown
en: How WordPress.com and WooCommerce are embracing AI with our official connections and MCPs.
zh: 关于 WordPress.com 和 WooCommerce 如何通过我们的官方连接器和 MCP 拥抱 AI。

speaker: Unknown
en: So please stop by the booth.
zh: 所以请到展位来。

speaker: Unknown
en: And yeah, thank you.
zh: 是的，谢谢。
